compound: vehicle (DMSO, matched to the highest compound vehicle fraction)
why_in_panel: defines zero; every geometry endpoint is expressed against it

compound: IGF1
why_in_panel: positive control for longitudinal growth. It is NOT a positive control for axial geometry - nothing establishes that it changes terminal-cell shape, and if it lengthens the bone without changing height-to-width it is the cleanest demonstration that length and shape are separable
concentration_basis: MUST BE SET FROM A CITED SOURCE BEFORE THE EXPERIMENT RUNS - none is invented here
what_it_falsifies: that a length gain must come with a shape change

compound: bafilomycin A1
why_in_panel: named by the brief. Stages 29-35 established V-ATPase inhibition is NOT an established growth intervention; it enters as a test of a prior claim
concentration_basis: MUST BE SET FROM A CITED SOURCE BEFORE THE EXPERIMENT RUNS - none is invented here
what_it_falsifies: that V-ATPase inhibition does anything to growth-plate geometry

why_in_panel: most-used compound in the corpus and the anchor paper's smallest length gain, acting through resting-zone expansion in embryonic tissue. One ROCK arm of several, deliberately not the lead
concentration_basis: published concentration, read manually from the source methods
concentration_source: PMC4516504 methods, read manually (E15.5 mouse tibia organ culture, 6 days)
what_it_falsifies: that the most-published ROCK tool is the right one

compound: cytochalasin D
why_in_panel: hard-rejected as a candidate. Defines what a large length gain WITH appositional widening and column loss looks like, so the gates can exclude it
concentration_basis: published concentration, read manually from the source methods
concentration_source: PMC4516504 methods, read manually (E15.5 mouse tibia organ culture, 6 days)
what_it_falsifies: that a length gain is sufficient evidence of productive growth

compound: jasplakinolide
why_in_panel: opposite-direction actin perturbation, same disorganised phenotype; shows the gate is not simply detecting depolymerisation
concentration_basis: published concentration, read manually from the source methods
concentration_source: PMC4516504 methods, read manually (E15.5 mouse tibia organ culture, 6 days)
what_it_falsifies: that the disorganised phenotype is specific to depolymerisation

compound: latrunculin B
why_in_panel: second depolymeriser with a different binding site, so the disorganisation control is not one compound's idiosyncrasy
concentration_basis: published concentration extracted from a bone or cartilage experiment - VERIFY against the source before use
what_it_falsifies: that the cytochalasin D phenotype is compound-specific

compound: hypotonic medium (reduced-osmolality DMEM)
why_in_panel: the brief's osmotic swelling control. Increases cell volume with no shape programme; any hit whose geometry resembles this arm is swelling, not remodelling
concentration_basis: MUST BE SET FROM A CITED SOURCE BEFORE THE EXPERIMENT RUNS - none is invented here
what_it_falsifies: that a height increase is a shape change rather than swelling

compound: mannitol
why_in_panel: hyperosmotic direction, so the swelling axis is two-sided rather than one arm
concentration_basis: MUST BE SET FROM A CITED SOURCE BEFORE THE EXPERIMENT RUNS - none is invented here
what_it_falsifies: that the swelling axis only runs in one direction
